# Law.com International highlights Burford's presence in Spain


December 8, 2025


-
-
-
-


Law.com International discusses draft legislation in Spain regarding class actions and highlights Burford's recent expansion into the Spanish market, noting that "Burford Capital, which manages a $7.5 billion portfolio globally, has already moved in, launching in Madrid in October with plans to expand."


Read more[here](https://www.law.com/international-edition/2025/12/08/spains-radical-class-action-shift-could-rewrite-the-rules-of-litigation/) .
